title: Keep one 90-minute work block distraction-free.
subtitle: Distraction boundary
rationale: Improve the quality of one real work block by keeping phone interruptions and desktop drift out.

evidence.summary: Reducing interruptions improves task accuracy and lowers the cost of resuming complex work.

indications: The phone sits in reach during focused work.
Work sessions fragment into stretches under 20 minutes.
Notifications interrupt more than once per hour.
